vendor: National Library of Medicine, National Institutes of Health, U.S. Department of Health and Human Services
product_family: PubMed is a free U.S. government service providing access to 40+ million citations and abstracts from biomedical literature. Core products include PubMed (web search interface), PubMed Central (full-text open access articles), My NCBI (user accounts with saved searches), and E-utilities API (programmatic access).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type I or Type II
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of SOC 2 certification. As a U.S. government service, PubMed does not pursue commercial security certifications.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification. As a U.S. government service, PubMed operates under FISMA (Federal Information Security Management Act) standards rather than ISO 27001.

certifications.name: HIPAA Business Associate
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA Business Associate certification. PubMed is a government agency subject to HIPAA regulations as a covered entity under HHS, but does not publicly claim HIPAA BA status.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: As a U.S. government service, PubMed does not claim formal GDPR compliance but processes data per NLM privacy policy; no public evidence of GDPR adequacy determination.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 (Cloud Security)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27017 certification. Cloud-specific certifications not mentioned in public policies.

certifications.name: ISO 27018 (PII Protection)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27018 certification. PubMed handles minimal PII and purges records after 410 days per policy, but no ISO 27018 certification claimed.

certifications.name: FISMA Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: As a U.S. government agency operated by NIH (Department of Health and Human Services), PubMed operates under Federal Information Security Management Act (FISMA) standards as required for all federal information systems.

certifications.name: OMB Guidance Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: NLM explicitly states compliance: 'NLM complies with requirements for privacy and security established by the Office of Management and Budget (OMB), Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), and the National Institutes of Health (NIH).' Cookie usage follows OMB Memo M-10-22.

certifications.name: HHS Privacy Standards
certifications.proof_quote: NLM complies with HHS privacy and security requirements: 'personally identifiable information is maintained in a database that is regularly purged after 410 days.'

privacy.ai_training_note: PubMed data is unrestricted for use and distribution per NCBI policy. No explicit AI training restrictions or opt-out mechanisms published. NCBI states: 'NCBI places no restrictions on the use or distribution of the data contained therein.' AI/ML training on PubMed data is technically permitted under these terms.
privacy.data_region: United States (Bethesda, MD - National Library of Medicine)

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: HTTPS enforced. NLM states: 'The https:// ensures that you are connecting to the official website and that any information you provide is encrypted and transmitted securely.'

security.name: Traffic Monitoring
security.value: NLM uses software programs to monitor traffic and identify unauthorized attempts to upload, change information, or cause damage.

security.name: PII Retention Policy
security.value: Personally identifiable information is maintained in a database that is regularly purged after 410 days.

security.name: Data Sharing Restrictions
security.value: NLM does not give, share, sell, or transfer personal information except as mandated by statute or law enforcement.

security.name: Cookie Policy
security.value: Session and persistent cookies (My NCBI) used only for technical functionality and user preferences, following OMB Memo M-10-22. Users may opt out in My NCBI settings.

security.name: API Rate Limiting
security.value: E-utilities API users advised to post no more than 3 requests per second; large jobs should run on weekends or 9 PM-5 AM Eastern time.

products.name: PubMed Search
products.data_scope: 40+ million citations and abstracts from MEDLINE, life science journals, and online books. Links to full text via PubMed Central and publisher websites.
products.notes: Free, web-based, government service. No login required for basic search.

products.name: My NCBI
products.data_scope: User accounts with saved searches, filters, document delivery settings, and institutional access links.
products.notes: Optional persistent cookie-based system. Users may opt out of persistent cookies.

products.name: PubMed Central (PMC)
products.data_scope: Full-text articles in open access subset. Includes PMC copyright restrictions enforced.
products.notes: Subset of articles available in full text; copyright restrictions per publisher agreements.

products.name: E-utilities API
products.data_scope: All PubMed data accessible via programmatic API. Rate limiting enforced.
products.notes: Open API for developers. Disclaimer and NCBI copyright notice required in derivative works.

products.name: Advanced Search & Clinical Queries
products.data_scope: Filtered search capabilities for clinical research, systematic reviews, and specialized queries.
products.notes: No additional data scope beyond standard PubMed.

compare.pricing_model: Free; no cost for any PubMed service. Fully government-funded.
compare.data_residency: United States - Bethesda, Maryland (National Library of Medicine servers)
